charts.name: Revenue and Bookings Chart
charts.formula: Gateway captured collections = deduped authenticated capture amounts by capturedAt. Bank collections = independently verified unique credits by bank_credited_at, verified by asOf. Total incoming collections = gateway captures + bank collections; net collections = total incoming - confirmed gateway/bank outgoing refunds and separately verified bank reversal movements (never duplicate the same reversal/refund). Claims and allocation events add no collections. Recognized revenue remains separate approved recognition ledger/service policy only, null if unavailable. Booking count = distinct confirmedAt booking IDs, source-independent (not receipt/credit count). Incoming excess/unmatched funds are real received money, never automatic booking or recognized revenue; disclose their balances separately.
